name: grand-theft-pundit
description: Grand Theft Pundit: a third-person open-city parody game about the pundit-industrial complex. Desktop build of the browser game.

scripts.dist:mac: npm run sync && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run sync && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run sync && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
